analysis.overall: Despite a great overall time in range, the day featured a few stubborn afternoon highs followed by extended low spells that required careful overnight management.

events.title: Afternoon peak
events.description: Glucose rose to 189 mg/dL following a series of close-together meal and correction boluses, eventually leveling off before drifting down.

events.title: Extended low dip
events.description: Levels lingered around the mid-50s for a prolonged stretch before carbs were introduced to help bring things back up.

events.title: Evening meal recovery
events.description: A 40g carb intake combined with a 4.1u bolus successfully nudged glucose out of the low zone and back into a stable upward trend.

events.title: Late night drop
events.description: A sharp downward trend brought levels down from 178 to 141 mg/dL rather quickly, which was then managed through overnight adjustments.

events.title: Morning dip
events.description: Early morning hours saw a gradual downward drift into the 60s, which stabilized nicely before breakfast time.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on insulin stacking during the late afternoon hours to avoid those stubborn highs and subsequent low stretches.
